theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_allard_wrm_gradient_term_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)) (W : Varifold N n U) (P : Grassmannian N n) (y : Euclidean N) (ε M A t : ℝ) (h : Euclidean N → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ), 0 ≤ ε → 0 ≤ M → 0 < A → 0 < t → (∫⁻ z in closedBall y (t * A) ×ˢ (univ : Set (Grassmannian N n)), ENNReal.ofReal ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap z.2 - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ ∂W.measure) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (ε * (t * A) ^ n) → (∀ (z : Euclidean N) (S : Grassmannian N n), |fderiv ℝ h z (Grassmannian.project S (z - y))| ≤ M * ‖LinearMap.toContinuousLinearMap (Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap S - Grassmannian.projectionLinearMap P)‖ * ‖z - y‖) → (∀ s, 0 ≤ φ s ∧ φ s ≤ 1) → (∀ s, A ^ 2 ≤ s → φ s = 0) → |∫ p, φ (‖p.1 - y‖ ^ 2 / t ^ 2) * fderiv ℝ h p.1 (Grassmannian.project p.2 (p.1 - y)) ∂W.measure| ≤ M * A ^ (n + 1) * ε * t ^ (n + 1)
